title: refactor(ci): unify lint/test/release workflows and simplify deps automation
author: Samir Patel
ci_status: pass (one lint flake fixed after rerun)
description: Motivation: our GitHub Actions landscape has accumulated a proliferation of redundant workflows for linting, testing, and release automation across packages. This increases maintenance cost, causes inconsistent caching behavior, and makes it harder to reason about failures. This PR consolidates the lint/test/release flows into a smaller set of composable workflows and centralizes dependency update automation to reduce noise and improve cache reuse. High level changes: implement a split of responsibilities between workflow dispatcher (workflow_call) and job templates; unify lint matrix, unify test matrix, add a standardized job for release notes generation and changelog tagging, centralize dependency-bot automation to one workflow with configurable labels and staged merges, and add stricter commit message and PR title validation to reduce noisy releases. Checklist: - [x] Consolidate lint workflows from 7 -> 2 (package-level and monorepo-level) - [x] Consolidate test matrices and standardize node/matrix strategy across SDKs - [x] Introduce reusable workflow templates for common jobs - [x] Replace several bespoke release action usages with a single standardized release job - [x] Add caching hygiene and improve cache keys for node and python jobs - [x] Update dependabot config and add gating labels for staged merges - [x] Run full monorepo CI and iterate on flakes - [x] Update docs/CONTRIBUTING.md to reflect new PR/commit checks Breaking changes: none to runtime code; CI-only changes. Migration notes: contributors should use the existing PR templates; most changes are transparent. If a package requires custom jobs, it can opt in to the package-level workflow_call. For maintainers: follow the PR to add package-specific exceptions in .github/workflows/overrides.yml if needed.
commits: 3 commits: 1) refactor(ci): add reusable workflow templates and dispatcher; 2) ci: consolidate lint/test workflows and update cache keys; 3) chore(ci): update dependabot config and docs
